answer.label: In short

It helps paid and SEO clients get more from the traffic.

stages.breaks: Nobody reads the funnel before changing pages.
stages.why: Without knowing where visitors leave, fixes land on the wrong page.
stages.does: We read the client's analytics funnel first and show you the largest drop before touching a page.

stages.breaks: The page hides delivery and returns.
stages.why: A buyer who cannot see cost and terms leaves to look elsewhere.
stages.does: Page reviews rank fixes by effect, so you can tell the client what to change first.

stages.breaks: The add to cart step sits out of reach.
stages.why: A button that is hard to find or tap costs sales on phones first.
stages.does: We check cart and checkout on phone and desktop and write each fix as a clear instruction.

stages.breaks: The enquiry form asks for too much.
stages.why: Every extra field is another reason to stop.
stages.does: We cut fields to what sales needs and test the shorter form against the old one.

stages.breaks: Tests run without a plan or a read-out.
stages.why: A test with no hypothesis teaches nothing, and the client hears that it did not work.
stages.does: Every test starts with a written hypothesis and ends with a read-out that includes the losses.
